NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Fair: Crafts, Discussions, and Tours
NewsArticle.Content: .01.09 Dartanian Lestor, Aisling and longstanding organizer in Mileth, writes of the first Aisling-hosted fair, hosted by Mileth Village: Mileth Festival: Registration and Sign-ups - Crafts, Discussions, and Tours Lectures and discussions- Contact Xilan for any questions and/or interest in any of these events. Craft Demonstrations- To be held twice a Temuairan week the first two and once on the last one. We need 2 representatives from each paths to speak about their paths and explain some of the crafts they do. We need interesting topics so try to steer away from just simply explanation and mechanics of how to do the event. ((i.e. For gem polishing, don't just say "Use the skill. Place a coin on the ground. Select whether with an assistant or alone." Try to make it interesting.)) Speech Platform A speaker will be able to sign up for a 4 Temuairan hour ((30 minutes)) block of time. There won't be additional time proportioned after unless all have signed up and the block is free. Aislings can use this time to talk about just about anything they wish in the area and time provided. The topics will be interviewed by the contact. Donations for the time used are greatly appreciated. The only topics that will not be allowed are heresy or bashing of other aislings. Tour Guides Guides will be set up to show aislings who wish the various sights in Temuair. The cost of the tour will be 500-1000 coins per aisling, depending on the size of the area covered and the quality of the tour. Guides sign up for a specific area as well as a shift they wish to take. They sign for either an 8 Temuairan hour shift or 2 tour sessions, whichever comes first with the exception that they are in the middle of a tour when the 8 hour shift ends. A guide coordinator is needed. The guides will be interviewed first for knowledge of the area. Here are the various areas covered and thenumber of guides required: - Mileth, the Crypts, and East Woodlands- 2 guides - Abel, Kasmanium Mines, and Abel Beach- 2 guides - Rucession and Dubhaim Castle- 1 guide - Piet, Piet Sewers, and Pravat Caves- 2 guides - Loures and Mehadi Swamp- 1 guide - Undine, Suomi, and the roads of Astrid- 2 guides Again, contact Xilan for details
